routes.reason: The stages SchemeAndStackFoundations:SF.0, SchemeAndStackFoundations:SF.4 own this: Own general perfection, pfp models, morphism properties, pushouts and formal blowup geometry once. Item S314 carries E28.
The stages SchemeAndStackFoundations:SF.1, SchemeAndStackFoundations:SF.3 own this: Reuse the Picard-groupoid owner found in PAPER-WITASZEK-22.

The stages SchemeAndStackFoundations:SF.3, SchemeAndStackFoundations:SF.4, SchemeAndStackFoundations:SF.5 own this: Supply general positivity, finite Frobenius power descent and Keel’s criterion from the existing divisor/intersection/birational foundations.
The stages EnhancedDerivedSheaves:E1 own this: These perfect-ring Tor, projective-dimension and valuation-module lemmas supply the existing derived-module foundation.

The stages EnhancedDerivedSheaves:E1, EnhancedDerivedSheaves:E2 own this: The existing coherent derived-sheaf and hyperdescent layers own unbounded Dqc, base change, boundedness detection and h-hyperdescent.
The stages EnhancedDerivedSheaves:E5:abstract own this: The early abstract monoidal enhancement owns descendability, quantitative tensor nilpotence and module descent once. Item Q1131 carries E50.

The stages EnhancedDerivedSheaves:E5:animation own this: Animated F_p-algebras, Frobenius discreteness and derived Witt adapters belong to the existing animation layer, with Witt-vector formulas imported from their coefficient owner.

The stages SchemeKTheoryOperations:S.1, SchemeKTheoryOperations:S.4 own this: The shared perfect-complex and scheme-descent layers own the enhanced Perf carrier, its Tor-amplitude strata and the four separate v-hyperdescent assertions.

The stages SchemeKTheoryOperations:S.2, SchemeKTheoryOperations:S.3, SchemeKTheoryOperations:S.4 own this: Own K of schemes and Witt complexes supported at p=0, localization, regular devissage and its sheafified extension. Item D515 carries E31.

The stages KTheoryLowDegrees:Z.3, KTheoryLowDegrees:U.3, KTheoryLowDegrees:U.6 own this: Extend the existing determinant and comparison interfaces to graded Picard targets, coherent perfect-complex determinants and the Witt-support determinant.

The stages GeneralAlgebraicKTheory:K.2:plus, GeneralAlgebraicKTheory:K.3, GeneralAlgebraicKTheory:K.4:construction, GeneralAlgebraicKTheory:K.7 own this: Reuse the Q/plus/S models and their comparison theorems.

The stages StableHomotopyKTheory:H.1, StableHomotopyKTheory:H.4 own this: The existing homotopy group-completion layer owns the Fin*-Segal construction, coherent subset model and bar/group-completion adjunction. Item A1205 carries E54.
The stages StableHomotopyKTheory:H.5:spectra own this: The early connective-spectrum layer owns iterated deloopings and the Picard/1-truncated-spectrum comparison.

The stages GeometricSatakeAndFusion:GS0:Witt-geometry own this: GS0 explicitly owns bounded Witt lattices, Demazure resolutions and projectivity. Items F620, G707, G818, G907, G1001 and S408 carry E27, E36, E37, E39, E41, E42 and E29.

The stages RelativeFarguesFontaine:RF0 own this: RF0 already owns the ramified Witt coefficient ring; §9 is an additional source for its group-valued geometric use, not another coefficient-ring construction.

The stages K2SymbolsBrauer:T.1:classical, K2SymbolsBrauer:T.1:plus, K2SymbolsBrauer:T.3:symbols, K2SymbolsBrauer:T.3:localization-comparison own this: The existing Steinberg and tame-residue layers own the stable K2 extension and localization-boundary comparison.

Reuse the candidate identifier and design scope newly supplied by PAPER-BHATT-MATHEW-21; this is an additional source for that one roadmap, not a second arc owner. The new roadmap is shared with Bhatt–Mathew (2021), Česnavičius–Scholze (2024), Clausen–Mathew–Morrow (2021) and Guo–Reinecke (2024) under the same title.

CR.4 owns ordinary Witt complexes and smooth comparisons; CR.7 explicitly leaves more general singular/nonproper theories to separate source-qualified extensions. The title already begins with the parent's atlas title; the brief names E52.

notes: Independent review REV-PAPER-BHATT-SCHOLZE-17 by Claude Code, session cc-2aeb03; the extraction was written by Codex (codex-c83e7a) and completed by Claude Code (cc-442dc5, #2124). arXiv:1507.06490v3, the version the extraction read (61 pages; hash matching), was read in full on page images in seven ranges against every item, with v1 and v2 compared where recorded mistakes concern them. Corrected in place: 139 item fields (73 statements, 63 locators, 2 kinds, 1 name) and 11 notes; seven items removed as not in the paper (L07–L10, L16, L17: tori, characters and cocharacters, which the paper never mentions; G816: a lemma of Keel the paper does not cite); 104 items added for definitions, constructions and cited inputs the proofs use; route 18's brief and the items of the source routes carry the confirmed corrections; prerequisites rebuilt as 28 cited works with DOIs or stable links. Statuses: all library declarations opened at the pinned commits and all planned stages checked. Mistakes: E1–E26 confirmed, nine revised as the independent checks upheld (E2 introduced in v3; E23 also in v2, with a counterexample; E17's correction replaced). 29 new claims were checked a second time, independently: 28 confirmed, 1 reclassified; with one found by an independent check they are E27–E56. The main new ones: Theorem 1.3 omits 'of finite presentation' (E27); Proposition 3.12 fails in the cardinality-truncated Perf (E28); Proposition 9.7 needs k algebraically closed (E41); gaps in Lemma 4.6 (E29), Corollary 5.6 (E31), Theorem 6.13 (E36), Lemma 7.7 (E37), Theorem 8.3 (E39), Proposition 10.1 (E42), Remark 11.24 (E50) and Proposition 11.41 (E52). Theorem 1.1 and the other main results stand.
